pursuit: End-to-end feedback architecture: real traces + AxGEPA (not MIPRO) + judge + archetype promotion + telemetry

base.note: R1 (drew/rlm PR #5) merged. Infrastructure shipped: product-brief generator, AxFlow variant_b nodes, router.tangle.tools integration, recall metric, CI, 367 tests. Hot path stable at recall 0.878 ideasai / 1.000 held-out / 1.000 vibecoder with p95 <0.5ms.

harnessPath: R2 is a multi-subsystem pursuit: src/training/**, scripts/**, src/lib/telemetry.ts, registry/layers/capability/**
note: R1 taught us: (a) AxMiPRO needs a Python sidecar we don't run. (b) The metric (Jaccard) was the ceiling, not the planner. (c) variant_b brief-loader regresses held-out by over-expanding into workspace lanes. (d) 12 judged-promotable archetypes sit unpromoted. (e) The richest signal source is uninstrumented: Claude Code session transcripts + every compose+validate run are labeled traces today, captured by nothing.

dimensionClaims.ideasaiRecall: Expected-⊆-actual recall on corpus/ideasai-prompts.json. Baseline 0.878. The metric that reveals whether GEPA training actually improves routing vs just memorizing. Target: >0.92.
dimensionClaims.heldOutRecall: Same metric on held-out. Baseline 1.000. Claim: any variant that trains on ideasai traces MUST NOT regress held-out — that's the overfitting gate. Hard floor: 1.0, zero tolerance.
dimensionClaims.briefP95Ms: End-to-end p95 when the brief-loader IS active (variant-provided). R1 variant_b hit 0.986ms but regressed held-out passRate 7pp. Target: p95 <500ms AND held-out passRate 1.0 — both must hold.
dimensionClaims.judgeAgreementRate: Pearson correlation between the variant's judge and a human-scored set. We will use two human-label sources: (a) Drew's mid-session corrections in the Claude Code transcript as negative/positive pairs, (b) the 12 existing archetype judgements in .evolve/ideas/variant_b.json. Target: r ≥ 0.7.
dimensionClaims.archetypePromotionYield: Count of archetypes the variant generates + judges promotable AND that are merged into registry/layers/capability/ AND that improve held-out recall. R1 produced 12 candidates, 0 merged. Target for R2: ≥3 actually merged with measured improvement.
dimensionClaims.telemetryCoverage: Boolean dimensions summed: brief-latency emitted? cache-hit-rate emitted? router-cost emitted? optimizer-iteration emitted? judge-score distribution emitted? archetype-promotion emitted? Target: 6/6.

constraints: All LLM calls MUST go through router.tangle.tools. Use createLLM() from src/lib/llm.ts only.
Use AxGEPA (@ax-llm/ax) — NOT AxMiPRO. AxGEPA is pure TS, no Python sidecar. AxBootstrapFewShot OK as a bootstrap seed for GEPA.
Reuse src/lib/llm.ts, src/lib/product-brief.ts, src/training/variant_b/* from R1. Extend — don't fork.
Extend scripts/meta-harness-eval.mjs + scripts/multi-pursue-eval.mjs. New eval metrics plug into the existing harness.
Trace storage: .evolve/traces/ append-only JSONL. Each event has kind + ts + payload.
Hot path (planPrompt default) stays deterministic. All LLM code behind flags or offline.
MUST add telemetry emission. Extend src/lib/telemetry.ts (existing).

structuralAxes.variant_d_transcript_first: Mine Claude Code session transcripts at ~/.claude/projects/**/*.jsonl for (prompt, attempt, correction, retry) quadruples. Primary training signal = Drew's corrections. Lower volume but high semantic signal. AxGEPA trained on correction-pair data.
structuralAxes.variant_e_compose_validate_first: Every scaffold composed + validated on the corpora is a labeled trace. Pass/fail + capHit = deterministic label. Much bigger data volume, zero human-in-loop needed. AxGEPA trained on labeled validate outcomes.
structuralAxes.variant_f_hybrid_weighted: Combines both signals. Transcript-derived pairs get higher weight (stronger signal), validate-derived get volume. Telemetry per-signal to track which source drives each optimization step.

rerunBaseline: Re-measured after R1 merge: ideasai recall 0.878 (±0), p95 0.44-0.48ms, bit-exact deterministic across 5 runs. Baseline frozen.
